visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor hair salon setting. A woman with light brown hair in a pink and white cardigan is seated, while another woman in a grey top stands behind her, smiling and making a peace sign. (2) Close-up shot of the woman with light brown hair in a bedroom, now wearing a green checkered blazer. She gestures toward her clear facial skin. (3) Sequence inside a brightly lit Olive Young retail store in Korea. The camera pans across crowded aisles and shelves filled with skincare products. (4) Product showcase of various yellow and white skincare boxes and tubes. A woman's face is featured on the packaging. (5) Demonstration of skincare application. The creator applies a clear serum to her hand, then blends it into her face. She then applies white, irregularly shaped sheet mask patches to her cheeks. (6) Studio setting. The creator, in a white bathrobe, sits at a table with the full product line arranged in front of her. She smiles and touches her glowing skin. (7) Detailed presentation of five specific products, each numbered on screen with close-ups of the bottles and texture. (8) Outdoor street montage. The creator is seen in various outfits, including a black leather jacket and beanie, showing off her skin in natural daylight. (9) Before-and-after comparison graphics appear on screen, showing split-screen views of skin imperfections and their subsequent improvement. (10) Bathtub scene. The creator is in a bath, wearing the cheek patches, with soapy bubbles visible in the background. (11) Final conclusion in the hotel room, where the creator holds up the products and gestures for viewers to comment.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 female assistant in first scene, and approximately 15-20 shoppers/staff in the store background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A fashionable East Asian woman with light brown hair, appearing in multiple outfits including a pink/white cardigan, a green checkered blazer, a white robe, and a black leather jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Varied settings including a professional hair salon, a hotel bedroom with a large bed and desk, a brightly lit Olive Young store with green signage, an outdoor city street in Korea, and a domestic bathroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins with an upbeat, electronic pop background music track. The voice is enthusiastic and clearly enunciated. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks the visual transition to the retail store, where a faint indoor room tone and distant crowd murmurs are present but well below the music level. (3) Multiple 'ding' and 'ping' sound effects occur in rapid succession as numbered product lists appear on screen. The narrator's speech rate remains high. (4) A 'pop' sound effect is heard as skincare serum is applied to the face. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (5) Final phase concludes with a bright 'digital chime' SFX accompanying the call-to-action, as the narrator's voice maintains a positive, high-valence tone throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence/Store Visit -> Top 5 Product Details -> Application Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and review the 'Easydew' skincare line by leveraging the 'Korean beauty' trend, showing the creator's personal results and travel to a Korean retail store to prove the products' popularity and efficacy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the 'Easydew' brand, detailed product descriptions, application demonstrations, and a final call-to-action for a group buy link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social media marketing video using fast-paced editing and aesthetic Korean travel footage to build trust for a skincare brand endorsement.
